title: TypeOverlay
description: The hub's overlay for one sample resource type (type-overlays/<type>.yaml): exactly the console and observe blocks of the platform change P-06, metadata.name of the type it applies to and the service it belongs to, and schema patches that add x-console hints to the type's fields. Merged over the platform's resource-types/<type>.yaml it gives the file P-15 adds to the platform; platform-fake reads both. A patch may also add a field the provider reports but no workflow sets (powerState on a vm), so observe.map can name it.

name.description: The ResourceType this overlay applies to (its metadata.name)

schema.description: Patches to the type's schema, by field

fieldPatch.description: The x-console hints of one field; type, title, description, enum and readOnly only when the patch adds an observed-only field
